message.content:
This editorial illustration shows a stylized man in a red suit standing on a curved, dark grey surface against a solid blue background. He is positioned left of center, holding a large grey sledgehammer with a wooden handle above his head as if about to strike downward. To his right, a large grey pencil is stuck vertically into the ground, its graphite tip buried and its eraser end frayed at the top.

At the top, black letters spell "TEMPO" across the center. Above this, white text reads "TRAGEDI JALAN 204 MINA" on the left and "PARA RAKSASA DI BISNIS DIGITAL" on the right. Below the magazine title is the date "28 SEPTEMBER-4 OKTOBER 2015".

The right side features large white capital letters stating "BEKING TANAH KETUA DPR". Smaller black text below reads: "Perebutan hak tagih Victoria Securities melibatkan sejumlah petinggi negara. Dari politikus Senayan hingga jenderal purnawirawan." A white barcode, price "RP 39.500", and "WWW.TEMPO.CO" are in the bottom left corner. A thick red band borders the left and bottom edges.
